text:
alex: Quick sync — we need to lock the ingestion contract for per-model/route SLO dashboards. Targets: P50/P95/P99 latency, TTFT_ms, tokens/sec. Console needs stable metric names and tags so rollouts don't break dashboards.

maya: Proposed metric names + tags (low-cardinality tags only: route, model_family, region, plan).

```text
# latency quantiles (ms)
redwood.slo.latency_ms{quantile="p50",route="$route",model_family="$model_family",region="$region",plan="$plan"}
redwood.slo.latency_ms{quantile="p95",...}
redwood.slo.latency_ms{quantile="p99",...}

# tail TTFT (ms)
redwood.runtime.ttft_ms{route="$route",model_family="$model_family",region="$region"}

# throughput
redwood.runtime.tokens_per_sec{route="$route",model_family="$model_family",region="$region"}

# quota burn
redwood.quota.consumed_units{route="$route",customer_tier="$plan"}
```

jonathan: Two infra points —
1) Cardinality: model_family not exact model to avoid explosion. If teams need per-model, provide an opt-in per-route label (model_version) with strict sampling.
2) Quantiles: we should emit summary/histogram from runtime (hdr/histogram buckets) not client-side percentiles.

tara: Console/UX asks that we expose stable panel variables: $route, $model_family, $region, $plan. Also include an ingest flag `dashboard_ready=true` to hide incomplete routes during rollouts.

luis: Sampling proposal: full sampling for latency/ttft for error traces; tokens_per_sec can be sampled at 5% by default with extrapolation. If route is high-volume (>1k r/s) increase to 1% to keep costs down.

emily: For rollouts we need a routing_label tag emitted by runtime: `routing_policy=primary|fallback|canary`. Dashboards want to pivot by routing_policy to show graceful degradation.

sli-bot: SLI proposal noted — will synthesize SLI definitions after we have final metric names. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: FYI deploy window Thurs 03:00-05:00 UTC for telemetry schema migration.

alex: Action items —
- I will update telemetry spec PR (infra/telemetry#421) with these names + sampling rules (due Wed EOD).
- @jonathan to add histogram export from runtime (ETA Tue).
- @tara/@maya to draft console panels with variables and `dashboard_ready` toggle (ETA Wed).
- @luis to validate cost model for sampling (quick calc in PR).

jonathan: quick note on ingest format (example proto snippet):
```
metric: "redwood.slo.latency_ms"
labels: route, model_family, region, plan, routing_policy
value: histogram(hdr)
```

maya: sounds good — once PR merged we'll opt-in a few routes (search, completions) for a pilot.

alex: Great — thanks everyone. If no blockers I’ll merge spec Wed and schedule the console handoff. :rocket:
